slices.title: proof-contract-freeze
slices.summary: Approved proof plan and typed contract now own the claim, boundaries, 23 slices, two human checkpoints, and discovery-first evidence cadence.

slices.title: semantic-beat-attention-matrix

slices.title: attention-scene-determinism
slices.summary: Added a pure range-neutral scene projector: each semantic beat yields one direct checkpoint or range seek against the canonical full timeline, with deterministic forward, reverse, interruption, and restoration behavior and no time authority.

slices.title: prose-object-focus-binding
slices.summary: Prose hover, keyboard focus, pin, and reconstructible URL intent now resolve through locked object bindings into the retained canonical session. Focus refreshes the current clock sample without seeking or advancing time; pin and Escape keep URL state coherent.

slices.title: algebra-attention-stage-projection
slices.summary: Added a query-selected, rollback-safe attention stage with twelve build-rendered semantic cues and Back/Forward navigation. It physically moves the one retained canonical equation stage, plays the existing ranges forward or backward, adds no clock or renderer, and leaves the searchable Article in document flow.

slices.title: stable-composition-and-fallback
slices.summary: Stabilized stage/passage/progress/buttons composition with reserved pre-enhancement geometry, safe stage insets, constant controls, animation-derived progress, scene-owned semantic attention, and ordinary page-flow fallbacks for short or zoomed viewports. The stage keeps one geometry unless the viewport constraint activates.

slices.title: discovery-smoke-and-capture
slices.summary: Captured one corrected Chromium exemplar after fixing stage overflow and static passage separators; focused semantic, no-JavaScript/searchability, canonical-clock, build, and visual checks pass. Payload observation exposes inherited eager-runtime budget debt without moving the discovery baseline.
